ms.report:
A. Output: A PreProduction Testnet–deployed smart contract, a PreProduction-tagged sidechain & client relayer, and the PreProduction Urban Farmer dApp, all deployed and operating on Cardano preprod. The two Aiken validators (Season Beacon and Cash Register) are confirmed on preprod; the append-only sidechain records each grow event and, at season close, the client relayer anchors the season's Merkle root on-chain.
Acceptance criteria: A Milestone Reviewer can use a PreProduction wallet and tRESI to open an account on the dApp and perform basic functions (e.g., start a planting). The deployed sidechain produces records that are cryptographically anchored to Cardano and independently verifiable.
Evidence:
・Live preprod dApp: https://urban-dev.resi.works
・Walkthrough proving deployment & functions: https://youtu.be/0cFFuzFOVGk
・Closed-season validation report: https://urban-dev.resi.works/validate/609dc9d3-a0e5-4183-9398-2c3b501587ec
・Raw validation JSON: https://urban-dev.resi.works/api/label-validator/609dc9d3-a0e5-4183-9398-2c3b501587ec
・On-chain anchor transaction: 6f219350de9ad21629c98e2deb26d8489c2c6ecf9710251b2015e7a1bce0b600 — https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/6f219350de9ad21629c98e2deb26d8489c2c6ecf9710251b2015e7a1bce0b600
